freeze_policy: Questions and relevance rules are fixed before either resolver is run. All queries are restricted to evaluation-split contributions and use only target IRIs in the validated local identity snapshot.

questions.question: Which evaluation-split contributions explicitly name Timmy Dooley, excluding contributions where he is already the structured speaker? What HouseTerm membership relationships can be joined from the mention?
questions.structured_baseline: Direct :speaker and ELI-DL participation-person relations in the Debate graph; these are not transcript-mention assertions.
questions.relationship_join: members:hasMembersMembership / members:inHouseTerm / existing HouseTerm houseCode and termNo
questions.relevance_rule: A returned contribution is relevant only if the transcript contains an explicit, entity-directed mention of this Member. A structured speaker relation is recorded as pre-existing information and excluded from incremental-result totals; it is not used as a substitute for a text mention.

questions.question: Which sampled contributions mention this Member during a period supported by the existing membership record, and what historic HouseTerm can be joined?
questions.structured_baseline: The Debate graph's existing speaker/participation links and the Member owner's dated memberships.
questions.relationship_join: dated Member membership / HouseTerm / enduring House
questions.relevance_rule: Temporal identity support must come from a validated membership interval; a name-only match outside those intervals is an abstention/error case, not a historical identity assertion.

questions.question: Which evaluation-split contributions explicitly identify Finance Bill 2025 (Bill 2025/60), and what status or legislative-process relationships can be joined?
questions.structured_baseline: DebateSection :refersToEvent links, if present and joined to the existing Bill graph; the Debate's section title alone is not a Bill identity.
questions.relevance_rule: Exact title/identifier wording is a mention candidate. Do not resolve against a Bill identity before the first source-supported legislative event; generic 'the Bill' remains unresolved without a unique source-local antecedent.

questions.question: Where do sampled contributions refer only to 'the Bill', and does the resolver correctly abstain instead of selecting Finance Bill 2025 from topic or debate context?
questions.structured_baseline: Existing Bill section links only; no identity is inferred from generic wording.
questions.relationship_join: No Bill join is valid unless an explicit, unique source-local antecedent is demonstrated.
questions.relevance_rule: A generic Bill reference is a detected unresolved mention. Linking it to the sole candidate in this intentionally tiny registry is a false resolution.

questions.question: Which evaluation contributions explicitly refer to the Taoiseach office as an office, rather than merely naming or referring to its incumbent, and what office-type relationship can be joined?
questions.structured_baseline: No Debate transcript-mention predicate exists; existing Member office holdings are separate source facts and do not assert that a contribution mentions the office.
questions.relevance_rule: A bare title can denote an office-holder. Accept only an explicit office/appointment context with a valid registry alias and date; otherwise retain an abstention.

questions.question: Which evaluation contributions unambiguously discuss the Minister for Finance office, and which reviewed AdministrativeUnit does that office head?
questions.structured_baseline: The reviewed office-to-unit relationship exists independently of speech text; there is no structured Debate-to-office mention link.
questions.relationship_join: members:headsAdministrativeUnit to the existing Department of Finance identity
questions.relevance_rule: A person/title metonym is ambiguous unless local wording establishes the institutional office as the referent. Respect the registry alias's candidate-matching validity start; it is not an office-establishment date.

questions.question: Which evaluation contributions explicitly name the Department of Finance, and which reviewed ministerial office has the existing headship relation to it?
questions.structured_baseline: No Debate transcript-mention relation exists. Do not infer a department from general finance subject matter.
questions.relationship_join: reverse members:headsAdministrativeUnit to the reviewed Minister for Finance office
questions.relevance_rule: The explicit reviewed unit name is a positive mention; similar administrative bodies and unnamed/generic Departments remain unresolved.

questions.question: Where do contributions refer only to 'the Department', and does the resolver avoid assigning that expression to the Department of Finance without a unique local antecedent?
questions.structured_baseline: No structured Debate-to-AdministrativeUnit mention relation exists.
questions.relationship_join: No unit relationship is valid without an explicit unique identity or antecedent.
questions.relevance_rule: Generic Department references are detected as unresolved by default; topic similarity is not identity evidence.
